services.desc: Tucked along the tranquil Chemainus River and bordered by majestic old-growth forests, Country Maples RV Resort is your year-round sanctuary. Located just a short drive from the charming town of Chemainus and only 14 km north of Duncan, it’s not only a picturesque setting but also remarkably accessible from the US, making it an ideal spot for both peaceful retreats and thrilling adventures. Whether you’re seeking a peaceful retreat or an action-packed adventure, our resort offers the perfect backdrop for your next getaway. Country Maples RV Resort features 136 well-appointed RV sites, equipped with full and partial hookups, including 8 pull-throughs and 2 RV for rent, for your convenience.
